description: This file contains Kotlin code implementing TLS configuration and fingerprint probing for network security within an Android application, including data classes, functions for building TLS configs, and fingerprint probing logic.

classes.name: GatewayTlsParams
classes.description: Data class representing TLS parameters including fingerprint expectations and flags.

classes.name: GatewayTlsConfig
classes.description: Data class encapsulating SSL socket factory, trust manager, and hostname verifier for TLS configuration.

classes.name: GatewayTlsProbeFailure
classes.description: Enum representing possible TLS probe failure reasons.

classes.name: GatewayTlsProbeResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of a TLS fingerprint probe, including fingerprint hash and failure reason.

methods.name: buildGatewayTlsConfig
methods.description: Constructs a TLS configuration object based on provided parameters, including trust management and hostname verification.

methods.name: probeGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Asynchronously probes a server for its TLS fingerprint, returning success or failure details.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 hash of input data and returns it as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: normalizeFingerprint
methods.description: Normalizes a fingerprint string by removing prefixes and formatting to lowercase hex.
